==========================
Scoped access on class names that spell a cast keyword
==========================

<?php
$x = new Binary($data, Binary::TYPE_GENERIC);
foo(Integer::class);
$y = Double::BAR;
$z = Real::class;
$w = Boolean::FOO;

---
